home.heroSubtitle: Proclaiming the lordship of Christ and gathering in worship, prayer, and the Word.
home.whoWeAreLead: We are a church in Irving, Texas, where you can draw near to God in worship, prayer, and the Word. We are glad to welcome you as you are.
home.pastorWelcome: At the end of the message, the pastor personally welcomes visitors, and you can greet him after the service.
home.whatToExpectLead: We want you to feel at home from the moment you arrive. Here's what to expect when you visit us.
home.expect1Text: A time of praise, preaching, and prayer. The Sunday service usually lasts about 2 hours.
home.expect2Text: At the end of the message, the pastor personally welcomes visitors, and you can greet him after the service.
home.expect3Text: Children's ministry (ages 3–10) on Sundays during the message, and youth participation/gathering every 3rd Sunday.

visit.title: We’re glad to welcome you
visit.lead: We want your first visit to be simple and welcoming. Here’s everything you need to know to come to church.
visit.parkingText: Parking: free in the church parking lot.
visit.contactText: If you have questions before coming, we’re happy to help.
visit.expect1: Worship: we begin by praising God together.
visit.expect2: Preaching: a biblical message for your life.
visit.expect3: Altar call/prayer: a time to respond and pray.
visit.welcomePersonal: If it’s your first time, at the end of the message the pastor will personally welcome you, and you can greet him after the service.
visit.kidsText: Children (ages 3–10, Sundays): during the message until the closing prayer. Leader: Claribel Garcia.
visit.youthText: Youth (ages 10–21): participate in the service every 3rd Sunday and meet after the service that day. Leader: Marlon Guevara.
visit.mapLead: Map to help you get to the church.
visit.faq1a: Yes, there is free parking in the church parking lot.
visit.faq2a: All our services are in Spanish.
visit.faq3q: What happens if it’s my first visit?
visit.faq3a: We’re glad to meet you. At the end of the message the pastor personally welcomes visitors, and you can greet him after the service.
visit.faq4a: Yes. On Sundays, children (ages 3–10) have their time during the message until the closing prayer.
visit.faq5a: Baptism takes place at the church after a person accepts the Lord. The date and time are coordinated with the pastor and can be any day. If you’d like to learn more or take this step, speak with the pastor.
visit.notifyLead: If you’d like, leave us your information and we’ll be happy to welcome you.
visit.formDay: What day do you plan to visit?
visit.formPrivacy: I agree to the privacy policy.
visit.formPrivate: When you submit, your message is sent privately to the church.

about.title: Our church
about.lead: Iglesia Apóstoles y Profetas Irving (IAPI) is a faith community in Irving, Texas, dedicated to proclaiming the lordship of Christ and gathering in worship, prayer, and the Word.
about.p2: For many years, our church has sought to be a place where families can know God and grow together in faith.
about.pastorRole: Pastor of Iglesia Apóstoles y Profetas Irving.
about.pastorDesc: With a heart for prayer, the Word, and pastoral care, the pastor welcomes everyone who visits and is available to greet people after services.
about.beliefsPlaceholder: Provisional content: We believe in Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior, in the authority of the Bible, and in a life of prayer, worship, and community. (This text is a placeholder and will be reviewed/confirmed by the church.)

give.title: Your generosity makes a difference
give.lead: Thank you for supporting the work of the church. We currently receive tithes and offerings through Zelle.
give.step1: Open your banking app and select Zelle.
give.step2: Add the recipient using the phone number shown.
give.step3: Verify that the displayed name matches the church.
give.step4: Enter the amount and an optional note (e.g. "Offering" or "Tithe").
give.notice: Notice: We do not collect payment information on this site. Offerings may be tax-deductible as applicable; consult your tax advisor. IAPI is recognized as a 501(c)(3) church.

legal.privacyBody: We collect only information you voluntarily submit through forms (visit, prayer, pastoral visit, contact, newsletter) to respond to and support your request. Prayer and pastoral requests are sent privately to the church and are not published. We do not sell your information. You can request access or deletion by contacting apostolesyprofetasirving@gmail.com.
legal.termsBody: Content on this site is provided for informational purposes for the IAPI community. We strive to keep information accurate, but it may change without notice. Use of this site implies reasonable acceptance of these terms.
legal.cookiesBody: We use essential cookies/local storage for basic functionality (such as remembering language). Third-party content (YouTube, maps) loads only when you request it (click-to-load) to protect your privacy. You can accept or reject non-essential cookies via the consent banner.
legal.accessBody: We want our site to be accessible to everyone. We work to follow WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines (semantic structure, alternative text, keyboard navigation, contrast). If you encounter a barrier, contact us at apostolesyprofetasirving@gmail.com or (903) 998-0338.
